game.title: A Date with Death
game.description:
You're just an ordinary person... or so you thought. For your entire life, you've been narrowly avoiding death by pure luck... or is it something more? When a strange program suddenly appears on your computer, and someone claiming to be the Grim Reaper says he's come for your soul, your life as you know it is thrown upside down.
  
  As you delve deeper into the mysterious man that calls himself the Grim Reaper, you begin to wonder if fate brought you two together for a reason. Can you resist his charm, or will you fall for the one destined to take your soul?
  
       
  A Date with Death is a supernatural romance chat simulator visual novel about the week long bet you enter against the Grim Reaper to attempt to keep your soul. Create your own character, from appearance to pronouns, decorate your apartment, and spend the (possible) last week of your life getting to know the one hunting for your soul.
  
  
       
  💀  Make Your Character:  Build your own protagonist, from their physical appearance to their pronouns and name. Update them throughout the game! 
  💀  Design Your Apartment:  Decorate your apartment to your liking and create a cozy space that you'll love coming back to. 
  💀  Pet Your Furry (or scaley?) Companion:  Yes, you can pet the dog. Snuggle up with your furry friend in-between chats.
  💀  Choices That Matter:  Make decisions that will affect your character's fate and lead you to one of multiple possible endings. What kind of relationship will you have with the Grim Reaper?
  💀  Beautiful Art of the Babygirl Grim Reaper:  Fill up your gallery throughout your playthrough with beautiful CGs, backgrounds, sketches, and more!

game.title: The Mermaid Mask
game.description:
In the pitch-black waters beyond a long-abandoned fishing town, the enigmatic captain of the world's strangest submarine has been murdered. Some say he was an immortal time-traveller. Others say he was a vampire, cursed to stay hidden beneath the waves forever...
  
        
  
  Found alone in a locked room, with only an ancient stone cauldron to suggest how he might have died, it's up to Detective Grimoire and Sally to piece together what really happened. Was it a curse, released from the cauldron? One of the submarine's eccentric crew? Or does the bizarre truth run even deeper...
  
        
  
  • Every clue is a fully realised 3D object waiting to be examined for hidden secrets  
 • Grimoire and Sally are back, and joined by a fully voiced cast of mysterious suspects  
 • A hauntingly beautiful original soundtrack performed by the Budapest Art Orchestra  
 • Explore every hand-painted inch of The Mortuga Submarine, where not all is as it seems...
  *Voice audio is only in English

En las oscuras aguas que rodean un antiguo pueblo pesquero abandonado, el enigmático capitán del submarino más extraño del mundo ha sido asesinado. Algunos dicen que era un viajero del tiempo inmortal; otros, que era un vampiro al que una maldición había condenado a ocultarse eternamente bajo las aguas...
  
        
  
  Tras hallarlo solo en un cuarto cerrado junto a un antiguo caldero de piedra como único indicio de cómo podría haber muerto, está en manos del detective Grimoire y Sally desvelar lo que realmente ocurrió. ¿Fue una maldición que salió del caldero? ¿Tal vez alguno de los peculiares tripulantes del submarino? ¿O la extraña realidad va aún más allá?
  
        
  
    Cada pista es un modelo 3D completo que examinar para revelar ocultos secretos
    Grimoire y Sally vuelven acompañados de un elenco de singulares sospechosos, todos con voz propia*
    Una banda sonora original tan bella como inquietante de Budapest Art Orchestra
    Explora todos los rincones pintados a mano del submarino Mortuga, donde nada es lo que parece...
    *Voces disponibles solo en inglés

Dans les eaux noires d'encre bordant un village de pêcheurs abandonné depuis des années, l'énigmatique capitaine du sous-marin le plus étrange au monde a été assassiné. Certains prétendent que c'était un voyageur du temps immortel, d'autres un vampire condamné à rester caché en mer de toute éternité...
  
        
  
  Après la découverte de son cadavre dans une pièce fermée à clé, avec un vieux chaudron en pierre pour seul indice quant aux circonstances de sa mort, c'est au détective Grimoire et à Sally de reconstituer ce qui s'est réellement passé. Malédiction libérée par le chaudron ou crime de sang perpétré par l'un des membres de son équipage, tous plus excentriques les uns que les autres ? À moins que la troublante vérité soit encore plus inattendue...
  
        
  
    Chaque indice est un objet en 3D travaillé dans les moindres détails qu'il vous faudra examiner en quête de secrets cachés
    Grimoire et Sally sont de retour, flanqués d'une galerie de mystérieux suspects aux voix entièrement doublées
    Une bande originale à la beauté envoûtante interprétée par le Budapest Art Orchestra
    Explorez chacun des décors peints à la main du sous-marin Mortuga, un lieu où les apparences sont trompeuses...
    *Doublage en anglais uniquement

Der mysteriöse Kapitän des seltsamsten U-Boots der Welt wurde in den tiefschwarzen Gewässern in der Nähe eines verlassenen Fischerdorfes ermordet. Es wird gemunkelt, dass er ein unsterblicher Zeitreisender war. Oder ein Vampir – dazu verdammt, für immer unter den Wellen verborgen zu bleiben ...
  
        
  
  Er wurde allein in einem verschlossenen Raum gefunden, in dem nur ein alter Steinkessel einen Hinweis darauf geben kann, wie er gestorben sein könnte. Detective Grimoire und Sally müssen herausfinden, was wirklich passiert ist. War der Kessel verflucht? War es jemand aus der exzentrischen Crew des U-Boots? Oder liegt die bizarre Wahrheit noch tiefer ...?
  
        
  
    Jeder Hinweis ist ein detailliertes 3D-Objekt, das nur darauf wartet, auf verborgene Geheimnisse hin untersucht zu werden.
    Grimoire und Sally sind zurück – zusammen mit einer vollständig vertonten* Crew mysteriöser Verdächtiger.
    Ein unheimlicher und schöner Original-Soundtrack, gespielt vom Budapest Art Orchestra.
    Erkunde jeden handgezeichneten Zentimeter des Mortuga-U-Boots, auf dem nicht alles so ist, wie es scheint ...
    * Die Sprachausgabe ist nur auf Englisch verfügbar.

Nel mare plumbeo di un villaggio di pescatori ormai abbandonato, è stato assassinato l'enigmatico capitano del sottomarino più folle al mondo. Per alcuni è un viaggiatore del tempo immortale. Per altri un vampiro, condannato in eterno a nascondersi negli abissi oceanici...
  
        
  
  Il corpo è stato rinvenuto in una stanza chiusa e con solo un antico calderone a suggerire la possibile dinamica degli eventi. Un mistero che solo i detective Grimoire e Sally possono ricostruire. Che sia stata una maledizione celata nel calderone? O uno degli eccentrici ospiti del sottomarino? Forse la verità è ancora più assurda e indecifrabile...

game.title: Bad Magpie Demo
game.description:
Bad Magpie  is a narrative adventure game about a magpie with one wing, a fixation on shiny things, and no interest in connecting the two dots.
  This demo drops you into a corner of one of the three areas in  Bad Magpie's  chaotic and colourful world, along with your first glimpse of the story behind the magpie's obsessive quest for shiny trinkets.
  In the full version, the story is told entirely through gameplay. For this demo, we've added a few lines of text before and after the gameplay to help set the scene.
  Your goal is to collect meteorite shards scattered across the map. Only the truly obsessive find them all.
   YOU ARE A MAGPIE         
  One wing. No flock. One obsession: a fallen star that wants shiny trinkets and nothing else.
  Burn a meadow, drain a swimming pool, write off a car… You can't fly but there are plenty of other ways to navigate the world… and you’re going to try all of them.
  Your plan is simple: Find the trinkets. Win over the star. Cure your loneliness. 
   A WORLD TEEMING WITH SECRETS         
  Explore a  densely packed, non-linear open world full of things to peck, steal, combine, and meddle with.
   Bad Magpie  runs on a delightfully elastic cartoon logic. Screech into a megaphone to shatter glass. Peck flint to spark fires. Drop an apple in oil and see what happens.
  Tear through the world in a fury, or carefully sweep every corner leaving no stone unpecked. There's no dialogue, no text, and no cutscenes. Just a world that rewards anyone curious enough to mess with it.
  Every puzzle has multiple solutions. Most of them are intentional.
   FIND SHINY THINGS         
  You want the star. The star wants trinkets. But trinkets don’t come free. Not when there’s meteorites to be found.
  So what’s the use of wallowing? You have shiny things to find.
   A MYSTERY DRIVING THE WHOLE THING         
  You are haunted by a mysterious vision. What is it? Why is it appearing now? And how long will the star keep you distracted from it? 
  It's probably nothing.
   KEY FEATURES     A luscious handcrafted world, reactive and brimming with life.
    Slapstick “got your nose” comedy.
    A cast of adorable critters to manipulate and terrorise.
    ASMR tactile interactions. Every peck, pull, and prod has been designed with maximum juiciness in mind.
    A dynamic score that orchestrates (and enables) your mischief.
    Disguises to unlock and hidden mechanics to discover.
    A powerful emotional narrative at the heart of everything, told without a single word of text or dialogue.
    
   One for sorrow… Two for joy?

Bad Magpie   es una aventura narrativa sobre una urraca con una sola ala, una fijación por las cosas brillantes y ningún interés en atar cabos.
  En esta demo jugarás en una de las tres zonas del caótico y colorido mundo de Bad Magpie. Esto te ofrecerá una pequeña muestra de la historia trás la obsesión de la urraca por las cosas brillantes. 
  Tu objetivo es recoger los fragmentos de meteorito que hay por el mapa. Solo la auténtica obsesión te permitirá hallarlos todos.
   ERES UNA URRACA         
  Una sola ala. Sin bandada. Y una obsesión: una estrella caída que solo quiere cositas brillantes.
   
  Quema el prado, seca una piscina, cárgate un coche... No podrás volar, pero hay muchas formas de moverte por el mundo... y tú vas a probarlas todas.
   
  Tu plan es sencillo:
   
  Encontrar las cositas brillantes. Ganarte a la estrella. Curarte de tu soledad.
   UN MUNDO LLENO DE SECRETOS         
  Explora un mundo abierto que está plagado de detalles que picotear, robar, combinar y trastear.
   
  Bad Magpie funciona con una maravillosa lógica de dibujos animados. Chilla en un megáfono para romper cristales, pica pedernal para prender fuegos, suelta una manzana en aceite para ver qué pasa...
   
  Arrasa con el mundo con furia o estudia cuidadosamente cada rincón sin dejar piedra sobre piedra. No hay diálogos, ni texto, ni cinemáticas. Solo hay un mundo que recompensa a los curiosos que se atreven a investigarlo.
   
  Cada rompecabezas tiene varias soluciones (la mayoría intencionadas).
   BUSCA COSITAS BRILLANTES         
  Tú quieres la estrella. La estrella quiere cosas que brillen. Pero no son gratis, especialmente cuando hay meteoritos por ahí repartidos...
   
  Así que no le des demasiadas vueltas, que tienes mucho que buscar.
   UN MISTERIO COMO HILO CONDUCTOR         
  Te atenaza una visión misteriosa... ¿Qué es? ¿Por qué se te aparece ahora? ¿Y cuánto tiempo te distraerá de ella la estrella?
   
  Bah, seguro que no es nada.
   CARACTERÍSTICAS     Un precioso mundo elaborado a mano, que reacciona y está lleno de vida.
    Comedia bufonesca e inocente.
    Un reparto de adorables criaturas a las que manipular y aterrorizar.
    Interacciones táctiles con ASMR. Cada picoteo, tirón y movimiento está diseñado para ser agradable al oído.
    Música dinámica que pone la banda sonora a tus fechorías (y las hace posibles).
    Disfraces que desbloquear y mecánicas ocultas que descubrir.
    Una narrativa emotiva y potente como hilo conductor, contada sin una sola palabra de texto o diálogo.
    
   Más vale pájaro en mano..., ¿no?

Bad Magpie  est un jeu d’aventure narratif ayant pour héroïne une pie dotée d’une seule aile, obsédée par les objets brillants et dénuée de toute intention de faire le lien entre les deux !
  La démo vous propose d’explorer une partie d’une des trois zones du monde à la fois chaotique et bariolé de  Bad Magpie , ainsi que d’obtenir un avant-goût du mystère qui se cache derrière l’apparente obsession de la pie envers les babioles brillantes. 
  Votre mission consiste à récupérer des éclats de météorites éparpillés à travers la carte. Mais attention, seuls les VRAIS pros de l’exploration seront en mesure de tous les trouver !
   VOUS ÊTES UNE PIE !         
  Une pie qui n’a plus qu’une seule aile, qui a perdu tout contact avec sa volée et qui est animée par une unique obsession : une étoile filante friande d’objets brillants… et de rien d’autre !
  Incendiez une prairie, asséchez une piscine, vandalisez une voiture… Vous ne pouvez peut-être pas voler, mais ce ne sont pas les moyens d’explorer le monde qui manquent… et vous allez tous les essayer !
  Votre plan est on ne peut plus simple :
  Trouver les bibelots et vous attirer les faveurs de l’étoile afin de trouver un remède à votre solitude !
   UN MONDE REGORGEANT DE SECRETS         
  Explorez un adorable monde ouvert non linéaire regorgeant de détails à picorer, à chiper, à combiner et à bidouiller !
  Bad Magpie s'appuie sur une logique de type « dessin animé » délicieusement élastique : vous pouvez par exemple crier dans un mégaphone pour briser du verre, ou donner un coup de bec sur du silex pour allumer un feu. Ou essayez donc de plonger une pomme dans l’huile, pour voir !
  Explorez le monde du jeu à toute vitesse ou prenez le temps d’explorer chaque recoin en prenant soin de n’oublier aucun détail. Dans Bad Magpie, il n’y a pas de dialogues, pas de textes ni de cinématiques. Juste un monde prêt à récompenser celles et ceux qui sont assez curieux·ses pour le retourner dans tous les sens !
  Chaque énigme peut être résolue de plusieurs façons différentes. Et d’ailleurs, la plupart des solutions sont intentionnelles !
   TROUVEZ UNE MULTITUDE D’OBJETS BRILLANTS         
  Vous voulez l’étoile. L’étoile veut des bibelots. Sauf que les bibelots, ce n’est pas gratuit... Surtout quand il y a aussi des météorites à récupérer !
  Alors à quoi bon vous apitoyer sur votre sort ? Vous avez tout un tas de trucs brillants à trouver !
   AU CŒUR DE TOUT, UN MYSTÈRE…         
  Une mystérieuse vision vous hante. De quoi s’agit-il ? Pourquoi apparaît-elle maintenant ? Et combien de temps l’étoile arrivera-t-elle à vous empêcher d’y penser ?
   
  Bah, ce n’est sans doute rien d’important…
   CARACTÉRISTIQUES     Un monde fantastique entièrement créé à la main, incroyablement réactif et débordant de vie.
    Humour burlesque et situations comiques du style « Je t’ai eu ! ».
    Toute une série d’adorables bestioles à manipuler... et terroriser !
    Des interactions tactiles 100 % ASMR. Chaque coup de bec, d’aile et de serre a été conçu pour procurer une satisfaction maximale.
    Une bande sonore dynamique qui orchestre (et rend possibles) vos méfaits.
    De nombreux déguisements à débloquer et mécaniques cachées à découvrir.
    Un scénario aussi captivant que riche en émotions, raconté sans aucun texte ni dialogue.
    
   Une pour le chagrin… Deux pour la joie ?

Bad Magpie ist ein narratives Abenteuerspiel über eine Elster mit nur einem Flügel, einer Vorliebe für glänzende Dinge und keinerlei Interesse daran, eins und eins zusammenzuzählen.
  Diese Demo wirft dich in einen Ausschnitt von einem der drei Gebiete in Bad Magpies chaotischer und bunter Welt. So erhältst du einen ersten Einblick in die Geschichte hinter der besessenen Suche der Elster nach glitzernden Kleinigkeiten.
  Dein Ziel ist es, über die Karte verstreute Meteoritensplitter zu sammeln. Nur wahrhaft Obsessive können alle finden.
   DU BIST EINE ELSTER         
  Ein Flügel. Keine Schar. Eine Obsession: ein gefallener Stern, der nur Glänzendes will und sonst nichts.
  Zünde eine Wiese an, leere ein Schwimmbecken, schreib ein Auto ab ... Du kannst nicht fliegen, aber es gibt jede Menge andere Möglichkeiten, dich in der Welt zu bewegen ... und du willst sie alle ausprobieren.
  Dein Plan ist einfach:
  Finde Glänzendes. Kriege den Stern herum. Kuriere deine Einsamkeit.
   EINE WELT VOLLER GEHEIMNISSE         
  Erkunde eine vollgepackte, nicht-lineare, offene Welt voller Dinge, die du picken, stehlen, kombinieren und an denen du herumspielen kannst.
  Bad Magpie basiert auf einer wunderbar elastischen Cartoon-Logik. Kreische in ein Megafon, um Glas zu zerbersten. Picke auf Feuerstein, um Funken zu entfachen. Lass einen Apfel in Öl fallen und schau, was passiert.
  Sause als Sturm durch die Welt oder durchkämme sorgfältig jede Ecke, um an jedem Stein herumzupicken. Es gibt keine Dialoge, keinen Text und keine Zwischensequenzen. Nur eine Welt, die alle belohnt, die neugierig genug sind, sich in ihr auszuprobieren.
  Jedes Rätsel hat mehrere Lösungen. Die meisten davon sind beabsichtigt.
   FINDE GLÄNZENDE DINGE         
  Du willst den Stern. Der Stern will glänzende Kleinigkeiten. Aber die gibt es nicht umsonst. Nicht, wenn es Meteoriten zu finden gibt.
  Was bringt es also, sich in Selbstmitleid zu suhlen? Du musst glänzende Sachen finden.
   EIN MYSTERIUM, DAS HINTER ALLEM STEHT         
  Du wirst von einer mysteriösen Vision heimgesucht. Was heißt das? Warum taucht sie gerade jetzt auf? Und wie lange wird der Stern dich davon ablenken?
  Es ist wahrscheinlich nichts.
   MERKMALE     Eine üppige, handgefertigte Welt, reaktionsfreudig und voller Leben.
    Slapstick-Komik nach dem Motto „Ich hab dir die Nase geklaut“.
    Eine Schar liebenswerter Wesen, die du manipulieren und terrorisieren kannst.
    Haptische ASMR-Interaktionen. Jede Schnabelbewegung, jeder Ruck und jeder Stoß wurde mit besonderem Augenmerk auf maximalen Genuss entworfen.
    Dynamische Musikuntermalung, die deine Streiche begleitet (und ermöglicht).
    Es gibt Verkleidungen zum Freischalten und versteckte Mechaniken zum Entdecken.
    Eine starke, emotionale Geschichte, die das Herzstück ausmacht und ganz ohne Text oder Dialoge erzählt wird.
    
   Eine für Kummer ... Zwei für Freude?

O jogo Bad Magpie é uma aventura narrativa sobre uma pega com apenas uma asa, uma fixação em bugigangas e sem qualquer interesse em ligar os pontos.
  Esta demo coloca-te no canto de uma das três áreas do mundo caótico e colorido do jogo Bad Magpie ao mesmo tempo que te dá o primeiro vislumbre da história por detrás da missão obsessiva de uma pega por bugigangas brilhantes. 
  O teu objetivo é colecionar fragmentos de meteorito que estão espalhados pelo mapa. Apenas os verdadeiramente obcecados conseguem encontrar todos.
   TU ÉS UMA PEGA         
  Uma asa. Sem bando. Uma obsessão: uma estrela cadente que quer bugigangas brilhantes e nada mais.
  Queima um prado, esvazia uma piscina, destrói um carro... Tu até podes não conseguir voar, mas há várias maneiras de explorar o mundo... e tu vais experimentá-las a todas.
  O teu plano é simples: Encontrar bugigangas. Conquistar a estrela. Curar a tua solidão.
   UM MUNDO CHEIO DE SEGREDOS         
  Explora um pequeno mundo aberto densamente recheado de coisas para bicar, roubar, combinar ou interagir.
  O jogo Bad Magpie é baseado na lógica irrealista dos desenhos animados. Tu podes gritar num megafone para fazer com que o vidro se parta, bicar uma pedra para começar um fogo. E se tiveres coragem o suficiente coloca uma maçã em óleo e vê o que acontece.
  Corre pelo mundo sem olhar para trás ou vê cuidadosamente cada canto e recando. Não há diálogo, nem texto, muito menos cutscenes. É apenas um mundo que recompensa os que são suficientemente curiosos para o explorar.
  Cada puzzle tem várias soluções. A maioria delas é intencional.
   ENCONTRA BUGIGANGAS BRILHANTES         
  Tu queres a estrela. A estrela quer bugigangas, mas elas não são de graça. Não quando há meteoritos para serem encontrados.
  Então porquê chorar sobre leite derramado? Tens bugigangas para encontrar.
   UM MISTÉRIO POR DE TRÁS DE TUDO         
  Uma visão misteriosa assombra-te. O que é? Porque é que está a acontecer agora? Durante quanto tempo é que a estrela te vai distrair dela?
  Não deve ser nada.
   CARACTERÍSTICAS     Um exuberante mundo feito à mão, reativo e cheio de vida.
    Um humor de palhaço tipo "apanhei o teu nariz".
    Um elenco de adoráveis criaturas para manipular e aterrorizar.
    Interações tácteis em ASMR. Cada bicada, puxão e espicaçada foi concebida para ser agradável ao ouvido.
    Uma banda sonora que orquestra (e permite) a traquinice.
    Disfarces para desbloquear e mecânicas secretas para descobrir.
    No coração de tudo está uma narrativa poderosamente emocional, contada sem uma única palavra ou diálogo.
    
   Mais vale uma pega na mão... que duas a voar?

Bad Magpie er et narrativt eventyrsspil om en skade med en vinge, en besættelse med skindende ting, og ingen interesse i at lægge to og to sammen.
  I denne demo bliver du smidt ind i hjørnet på en af de tre områder i Bad Magpies kaotiske og farverige verden, sammen med et lille glimt af historien bag skadens ustoppelige søgen på skinnende skatte.
  Dit mål er at samle stykker af meteorit, som er spredt omkring området. Kun de mest besatte kan finde dem alle.
   DU ER EN SKADE         
  En vinge, ingen flok, en besættelse: en falden stjærne som vil have skindende skatte og intet andet.
  Brænd en mark, tøm et basin, afskriv en bil... du kan ikke flyve, men der er mange måder at komme rundt på, og du vil prøve dem alle.
  Planen er enkel: Find skattene, vind over stjernen, og hel din ensomhed.
   EN VERDEN FULD AF HEMMELIGHEDER         
  Udforsk en tætpakket åben verden fuld af ting der kan prikkes til, stjæles, slås sammen, eller pilles ved.
  Bad Magpie følger den elastiske og dejlige tegnefilmslogik. Skrig i en megafon for at smadre glas, prik til lidt flint for at starte en ild, smid et æble i olie og se hvad der sker.
  Verden kan både hurtigt rases, og langsomt udforskes. Der er ingen dialog, ingen tekst, ingen scener. Bare en verden som belønner lidt nysgerrighed.
  Hver udfordring har adskillige løsninger. De fleste af dem er hensete.
   FIND TING DER SKINNER         
  Du vil have stjernen. Stjernen vil have skatte. Skatte findes ikke gratis, ikke når der er meteoritter af finde.
  Så der ingen grund til at måbe, der er skinnende ting at finde!
   DET STORE MYSTERIE         
  Du gives en mystisk vision. Hvad er det? Hvorfor er den her nu? Og hvor længe kan stjernen distrahere dig fra det?
  Det er nok ikke noget.
   INDHOLD     En frodig håndlavet verden fuld af liv som reagerer på hvad du gør.
    Masser af slapstick comedy af "jeg har taget din næse" slagsen.
    En masse små og søde dyr til at styre og terrorisere.
    ASMR-fyldte taktile interaktioner. Hvert prik, træk og hak er designed så lækkert som muligt.
    Dynamisk soundtrack der orkestrerer (og opfordrer) dine løjer.
    Forklædninger af finde, og gemte mekanismer at opdage.
    En følselsesladet historie i midten af det hele, fortalt uden en enkelt replik eller tekst.
  
     En for sørg... to for glæde?

Bad Magpie  è un'avventura narrativa che ha come protagonista una gazza con un'ala sola, una fissazione per gli oggetti luccicanti e nessun interesse a collegare i puntini.
  Questa demo ti catapulta in un angolo di una delle tre aree del caotico e colorato mondo di Bad Magpie, offrendoti un primo assaggio della storia che si cela dietro l'ossessiva ricerca dei gingilli luccicanti da parte della gazza.
  Il tuo obiettivo è raccogliere i frammenti di meteorite sparsi per la mappa. Solo chi ha una vera ossessione riuscirà a trovarli tutti.
   SEI UNA GAZZA         
  Hai un'ala sola. Nessuno stormo. E un'unica ossessione: una stella cadente che desidera soltanto gingilli luccicanti.
  Incendia un prato, svuota una piscina, distruggi un'auto... non puoi volare, ma ci sono molti altri modi per esplorare il mondo... e tu li proverai tutti.
  Il tuo piano è semplice.
  Trovare i gingilli. Conquistare la stella. Curare la tua solitudine.
   UN MONDO PIENO DI SEGRETI         
  Esplora un mondo open world denso di dettagli e non lineare, pieno di cose da beccare, rubare, combinare e con cui impicciarsi.
  Bad Magpie si basa su una logica cartoonesca deliziosamente elastica. Strilla in un megafono per mandare in frantumi un vetro. Becca una selce per appiccare incendi. Lascia cadere una mela nell'olio e guarda che succede.
  Attraversa il mondo in preda alla furia, oppure esplora ogni angolo senza lasciare nulla al caso. Non ci sono dialoghi, testi o filmati. Solo un mondo che ricompensa chiunque sia abbastanza curioso da metterci il becco.
  Ogni enigma ha più soluzioni. La maggior parte di esse è intenzionale.
   TROVA COSE LUCCICANTI         
  Tu vuoi la stella. La stella vuole i gingilli. Ma i gingilli non si ottengono gratis. Non quando ci sono meteoriti da trovare.
  Quindi a che serve crogiolarsi nella tristezza? Hai delle cose luccicanti da trovare.
   UN MISTERO CHE MUOVE TUTTO         
  Una visione misteriosa ti perseguita. Cos'è? Perché appare proprio adesso? E per quanto tempo la stella riuscirà a distrarti da essa?
  Probabilmente non è nulla.
   CARATTERISTICHE     Un mondo fantastico realizzato a mano, reattivo e traboccante di vita.
    Comicità slapstick in stile "ti ho preso il naso".
    Un cast di adorabili creaturine da manipolare e terrorizzare.
    Interazioni tattili 100% ASMR. Abbiamo progettato ogni beccata, strattone e colpetto per risultare incredibilmente soddisfacente.
    Una colonna sonora dinamica che orchestra (e favorisce) i tuoi misfatti.
    Travestimenti da sbloccare e meccaniche nascoste da scoprire.
    Una potente narrazione emotiva al centro di tutto, raccontata senza una singola parola di testo o dialogo.
    
   Uno per il dolore... due per la gioia?

game.brief:
Bad Magpie  is a narrative adventure game about a magpie with one wing, a fixation on shiny things, and no interest in connecting the two dots.
  This demo drops you into a corner of one of the three areas in  Bad Magpie's  chaotic and colourful world, along with your first glimpse of the story behind the magpie's obsessive quest for shiny trinkets.
  In the full version, the story is told entirely through gameplay. For this demo, we've added a few lines of text before and after the gameplay to help set the scene.
  Your goal is to collect meteorite shards scattered across the map. Only the truly obsessive find them all.
   YOU ARE A MAGPIE         
  One wing. No flock. One obsession: a fallen star that wants shiny trinkets and nothing else.
  Burn a meadow, drain a swimming pool, write off a car… You can't fly but there are plenty of other ways to navigate the world… and you’re going to try all of them.
  Your plan is simple: Find the trinkets. Win over the star. Cure your loneliness. 
   A WORLD TEEMING WITH SECRETS         
  Explore a  densely packed, non-linear open world full of things to peck, steal, combine, and meddle with.
   Bad Magpie  runs on a delightfully elastic cartoon logic. Screech into a megaphone to shatter glass. Peck flint to spark fires. Drop an apple in oil and see what happens.
  Tear through the world in a fury, or carefully sweep every corner leaving no stone unpecked. There's no dialogue, no text, and no cutscenes. Just a world that rewards anyone curious enough to mess with it.
  Every puzzle has multiple solutions. Most of them are intentional.
   FIND SHINY THINGS         
  You want the star. The star wants trinkets. But trinkets don’t come free. Not when there’s meteorites to be found.
  So what’s the use of wallowing? You have shiny things to find.
   A MYSTERY DRIVING THE WHOLE THING         
  You are haunted by a mysterious vision. What is it? Why is it appearing now? And how long will the star keep you distracted from it? 
  It's probably nothing.
   KEY FEATURES     A luscious handcrafted world, reactive and brimming with life.
    Slapstick “got your nose” comedy.
    A cast of adorable critters to manipulate and terrorise.
    ASMR tactile interactions. Every peck, pull, and prod has been designed with maximum juiciness in mind.
    A dynamic score that orchestrates (and enables) your mischief.
    Disguises to unlock and hidden mechanics to discover.
    A powerful emotional narrative at the heart of everything, told without a single word of text or dialogue.
    
   One for sorrow… Two for joy?

game.title: Freud's Bones-the game
game.description:
Freud's Bones is a surreal and obscure adventure on the study of psychoanalysis and Sigmund Freud. 
 Immerse yourself in Freud's mind and discover the mystery behind his crisis.
 Investigate ominous Egyptian artifacts, existential crises and become a petulant inner voice.
 
       
       
 Psychoanalyse Freud's patients and explore their unconscious to discover their hidden dreams, their obsessions and the causes of their deepest sexual disturbances. 
 Thanks to your help they could finally heal… though if not careful, your mistakes could lead them into a whirlwind of pain.
 
       
 
       
 Freud is being torn apart by a profound existential crisis. Exiled from psychoanalytic society, embroiled in controversial relationships, he lives every day in anguish, despite mending the souls of his patients, his own consciousness is unstable. In the night Egyptian artifacts in his office come to life, showing him threatening and disturbing philosophical puzzles and driving him to the brink of insanity. 
 
       
 Live Freud's everyday life by accompanying him in his routine: read the letters he receives every morning, give him a few moments of relaxation to smoke his beloved cigars or to drink a sip of cocaine. Accompany him to the Eckman Café to meet patrons who could finance his projects or go on the nocturnal walks among the palaces in Vienna.
 
       
 Fortuna "Axel Fox" Imperatore worked in a cleaning company while completing her studies in Psychology and Philosophy. Obsessed by her love of video games and psychoanalysis, she decided to put her mantra into practice: "Stay Hungry, Stay Foolish" and combine her greatest passions into a project, Freud's Bones, which was born from a rickety old laptop and through a myriad of adventures. In 2020, the Kickstarter campaign tripled its goal, raising €15,500 from all over the world. Alone, and equipped with a sense of stubbornness and craziness, Fortuna quit her job, invested her salary in the project and dedicated her body and soul to her first work.

Freud's Bones es una aventura surrealista y oscura sobre el psicoanálisis y Sigmund Freud.
 Sesiones de análisis y signos a descifrar. El estudio del Dr. Freud no es sólo un estudio.
       
       
 Psicoanaliza a los pacientes de Freud y explora su inconsciente, para descubrir sus sueños ocultos, sus obsesiones, así como las causas de sus trastornos sexuales.
 Gracias a tu ayuda podrían finalmente curarse... 
 Por tus errores, podrían derrumbarse en un torbellino de dolor.
       
 
       
 Freud encuentra un extraño artefacto egipcio en su escritorio, que "cobra vida" durante la noche mostrándole amenazantes e inquietantes enigmas filosóficos. Esto lo enloquece y lo vuelve paranoico haciéndole creer que es perseguido...
 
       
 Vive el día a día de Freud acompañándole en su rutina: lee las cartas que recibe cada mañana, dale unos momentos de relax para que se fume sus queridos puros o se beba un trago de cocaína. 
 Acompañarle al Café Eckman para conocer a los mecenas que podrían financiar su proyecto o realizar los paseos nocturnos entre los palacios de Viena.
 
 
       
 Fortuna "Axel Fox" Imperatore trabajaba en una empresa de limpieza mientras completaba sus estudios de Psicología y Filosofía. 
 Obsesionada por su afición a los videojuegos y al psicoanálisis, decidió poner en práctica su mantra: "Stay Hungry, Stay Foolish" y combinar sus mayores pasiones en un proyecto, Freud's Bones que nació de un viejo y desvencijado portátil y a través de un sinfín de aventuras.
 En 2020, la campaña de Kickstarter triplicó su objetivo, recaudando 15.500 euros de todo el mundo. Sola, y provista de un sentido de la terquedad y la locura, Fortuna dejó su trabajo, invirtió su sueldo y se dedicó en cuerpo y alma a su primera obra.

Freud's Bones è un'avventura surreale e intrapsichica su Sigmund Freud.
 Immergiti nella mente di Freud e scopri il mistero dietro la sua crisi.
 Indaga su inquietanti manufatti egizi, crisi esistenziali e diventa una petulante voce interiore.
       
       
 Psicoanalizza i pazienti di Freud ed esplora il loro inconscio per scoprire i loro sogni nascosti, le loro ossessioni, nonché le cause dei loro disturbi sessuali.
 Grazie al tuo aiuto potrebbero finalmente guarire...
 A causa dei tuoi errori, potrebbero crollare in un vortice di dolore.
 Per colpa tua, Freud potrebbe non uscirne mai.
       
       
 Freud è dilaniato da una crisi esistenziale profonda. Esiliato dalla società psicoanalitica, invischiato in rapporti controversi, vive ogni giorno con angoscia nonostante tessa le anime dei suoi pazienti.
       
 Vivi la quotidianità di Freud accompagnandolo nella sua routine: leggi le lettere che riceve ogni mattina, regalagli qualche momento di relax per fumare i suoi amati sigari o per bere un sorso di cocaina.
 Accompagnalo all'Eckman Café per incontrare mecenati che potrebbero finanziare il suo progetto o nelle sue passeggiate notturne tra i palazzi di Vienna.
    
 
       
 Fortuna "Axel Fox" Imperatore ha lavorato in un'impresa di pulizie mentre completava i suoi studi in Psicologia e Filosofia.
 Ossessionata dal suo amore per i videogiochi e la psicoanalisi, ha deciso di mettere in pratica il suo mantra: "Stay Hungry, Stay Foolish" e unire le sue più grandi passioni in un progetto: Freud's Bones, nato da un vecchio laptop traballante e attraverso una miriade di avventure.
 Nel 2020, la campagna Kickstarter ha triplicato il suo obiettivo, raccogliendo 15.500€ da tutto il mondo. Sola e dotata di un senso di testardaggine e follia, Fortuna ha lasciato il lavoro, ha investito i suoi stipendi e ha dedicato anima e corpo alla sua opera prima.

 Thanks to your help they could finally heal… though if not careful, your mistakes could lead them into a whirlwind of pain.
 
       
 
       
 Freud is being torn apart by a profound existential crisis. Exiled from psychoanalytic society, embroiled in controversial relationships, he lives every day in anguish, despite mending the souls of his patients, his own consciousness is unstable. In the night Egyptian artifacts in his office come to life, showing him threatening and disturbing philosophical puzzles and driving him to the brink of insanity. 
 
       
 Live Freud's everyday life by accompanying him in his routine: read the letters he receives every morning, give him a few moments of relaxation to smoke his beloved cigars or to drink a sip of cocaine. Accompany him to the Eckman Café to meet patrons who could finance his projects or go on the nocturnal walks among the palaces in Vienna.
 
       
 Fortuna "Axel Fox" Imperatore worked in a cleaning company while completing her studies in Psychology and Philosophy. Obsessed by her love of video games and psychoanalysis, she decided to put her mantra into practice: "Stay Hungry, Stay Foolish" and combine her greatest passions into a project, Freud's Bones, which was born from a rickety old laptop and through a myriad of adventures. In 2020, the Kickstarter campaign tripled its goal, raising €15,500 from all over the world. Alone, and equipped with a sense of stubbornness and craziness, Fortuna quit her job, invested her salary in the project and dedicated her body and soul to her first work.

game.title: Everyday Devil
game.description:
Ah, what's a devil to do in this day and age... Looking back at the past, I'm not sure if I learnt anything. Was there something to, in the first place? May you be my judge, jury and executioner, dear player, as you venture through my mind and life. Through my mistakes and plights. Welcome, to my everyday~ 
  
     
  
  A short, linear story game revolving around fragments of a random demon guy's life.
  The scattered pieces of memory are short, and somewhat disjointed... it's mostly a lot of walking and talking. The style of it may be a little different between each vignette, depending on Cecil's feelings at the time.
  
  It's a strange world, full of darkness.
  But it's just everyday life for him.
  I hope you understand.
  
  FEATURES    About an hour long experience
    Atmospheric levels of varying styles
    Characterization of creatures to both love and hate
    A feeling of despair, but also of coziness
    CONTENT WARNING    Contains themes of abuse, alcoholism, animal harm, blood/gore, violence and has flashing/eyestrain

game.description:
Numbers aren't worth anything in NMBR 9 unless they're off the ground floor and looking down from above.

The game includes twenty cards numbered 0-9 twice and eighty tiles numbered 0-9; each number tile is composed of squares in some arrangement. After shuffling the deck of cards, draw and reveal the first card. Each player takes a number tile matching the card and places it on the table. With each new card drawn after that, each player takes the appropriate number tile, then adds it to the tiles that they already have in play, with each player building their own arrangement of tiles.

The new tile must touch at least one other tile on the same level along one side of a square. A tile can also be placed on top of two or more other tiles as long as no part of the new tile overhangs the tiles below it; new tiles placed on this same level must touch at least one other tile, while also covering parts of at least two tiles and not overhanging.

Once all the cards have been drawn and the tiles placed, players take turns calculating their score. A tile on the bottom level — the 0th level, if you will — scores 0 points; a tile on the 1st level above this is worth as many points as the number on the tile; a tile on the 2nd level is worth twice the number on the tile; etc. Whoever scores the most points wins!

game.title: Key Harvest
game.description:
Key Harvest is the fifth game in the key series of games published by R&D Games.

The object of the game is to score the most points.  Players score points by placing tiles on their own country board.  One point is scored for each field tile in the player's largest group of connected field tiles and two points for each tile in their second largest connected group.

Points are also scored for the worker tiles a player places on their country board.  The number of points scored for each worker is equal to the number on the worker tile.  Worker tiles do not count as connecting tiles when calculating the largest group of tiles.  When played, a worker enables a player to take a special action.  Each player has their own team of six workers, known as farmhands.  There are also six townsfolk who can be acquired by any player.

There are usually six field tiles available at any time from the registry.  On their turn a player may bid for up to two tiles using crop counters.  The field tile being bid for and the bid in crop counters are placed in the player's store.  On their turn the other players may match the store owner's bid in both the number and type of crop counters.  If they choose to do so, then they place the field tile on their country board and pay the crop counters to the store owner.  If no other player has matched the store owner's bid, then on their next turn the store owner may place the field tile(s) from their store onto their country board and pay their bid in crop counters to the general stock.

When deciding how much to bid for a field tile, players will need to consider how important the field tile is to them and whether other players are likely to bid for the tile.  It is usually beneficial for a player to place field tiles into their store as that player will either obtain the field tile or receive additional crop counters.

When played, a worker tile must be adjacent to at least the number of field tiles as the number on the worker tile.  A worker tile cannot be adjacent to another worker tile.  If a player obtains a field tile for a space where they have already placed a worker tile, they must remove the worker tile.  However, if the worker tile can be replaced immediately (next to the required number of field tiles), then the player can benefit from the worker's ability again.  Getting these extra benefits is one of the keys to doing well in the game.

Players have two actions per turn.  There are four possible actions.  Each action can only be performed once per turn.  As described above, the actions include placing field tiles from the stores onto their country board - action (c), placing field tiles from the registry into their store - action (d), and placing a worker tile onto their country board - action (b).  Action (c) cannot be performed after action (d).  A player may also harvest crops by turning over some unharvested field tiles on their country board - action (a).

Field tiles taken from the registry are replaced immediately with field tiles from the bag.  The bag also contains a number of event tiles.  The event tiles, when drawn, affect all of the players, not just the player who drew the event tile.  When the tenth event tile is drawn, the game ends after two further rounds have been played.

One point is also awarded to the players who have the most of each of the types of crop counters at the end of the game.  No points are awarded for ties.  Points are tallied using the scoring track on the town board.  The player with the most points is the winner.

Nr. 4 in the QWG Master Print Edition series, as Demetra

game.title: Cave Story
game.description:
Arguably the most well-known indie game of all time, Cave Story features a completely original storyline wrapped with personality, mystery and hours of fast-paced fun. Cave Story is an action-adventure game from the critically acclaimed independent designer, Daisuke Amaya--or Pixel to his fans. Overflowing with unmatched charm and character, Cave Story takes you into a rare world where a curious race of innocent rabbit-like creatures, called Mimigas, run free.
 						You wake up in a dark cave with no memory of who you are, where you came from or why you're in such a place. Uncovering Mimiga Village you discover that the once-carefree Mimigas are in danger at the hands of a maniacal scientist. The Mimigas’ only hope rest squarely on the shoulders of a quiet, amnesiac boy who can't remember his own name.
 						Run, jump, shoot, fly and explore your way through a massive action-adventure reminiscent of classic 8- and 16-bit games. Take control and learn the origins of this world’s power, stop the delusional villain and save the Mimiga!
 						 Key Features: 						  Original (320x240) graphics and upgraded “HD” graphics
 						  Remastered music as well as the original soundtrack
 						  Mix-and-match new/old artwork and music!
 						  Six new play modes (including Wind Fortress, Boss Rush and more!)
 						  Over 20 epic boss battles through Mimiga Island
 						  15 levels to explore in the vast world
 						  10 unique weapons to find and upgrade
 						  USB controller compatibility
 						  Four unique endings
 						  Future content updates

Cave Story es un juego de acción y aventuras del diseñador independiente aclamado por la crítica Daisuke Amaya, o Pixel para sus fans. Con una personalidad y un encanto arrolladores, Cave Story te transporta a un extraño mundo en el que una curiosa raza de inocentes criaturas conejiles, llamadas Mimigas, campan en libertad.
 Te despiertas en una oscura cueva sin recordar quién eres, de donde vienes o por qué estás en este lugar. Al descubrir el Poblado Mimiga compruebas que los anteriormente despreocupados Mimigas se encuentran en peligro a manos de un científico maníaco. La única esperanza de los Mimigas descansa sobre los hombros de un silencioso chico amnésico que no recuerda ni su propio nombre.
 Corre, salta, dispara, vuela y explora a lo largo de una aventura de acción con el sabor de los clásicos de 8 y 16 bits. ¡Toma el control y descubre el origen del poder de este mundo, detén al iluso villano y salva a los Mimiga!    Música remasterizada además de la banda sonora original

   Seis modos de juego (¡incluyendo Wind Fortress, Boss Rush y muchos más!)
   Más de 20 épicos encuentros con jefes a lo largo de la Isla Mimiga

Cave Story est un jeu d'action-aventure développé par le concepteur indépendant récompensé par la critique, Daisuke Amaya -- ou Pixel pour ses fans. Débordant d'un charme et d'un caractère sans pareils, Cave Story vous emporte dans un monde rare où une curieuse race de créatures innocentes ressemblant à des lapins, les Mimigas, est en toute liberté.
 Vous vous réveillez dans une caverne sombre sans souvenirs de qui vous êtes, d'où vous venez ou de pourquoi vous êtes dans un tel endroit. En découvrant Mimiga Village, vous vous apercevez que les insouciants Mimigas sont en danger, des mains d'un scientifique maniaque. Le seul espoir des Mimigas repose sur les épaules d'un garçon calme et amnésique qui ne peut pas se rappeler de son propre nom.
 Courez, sautez, tirez, volez et explorez à travers ce jeu d'action-aventure rappelant les classiques de l'époque 8- et 16-bit. Prenez le contrôle et apprenez les origines du pouvoir de ce monde, arrêtez le délirant méchant et sauvez les Mimiga ! Caractéristiques :   Graphismes originaux (320x240) et graphismes “HD” améliorés

Als wohl bekanntestes Indie Spiel aller Zeiten, beinhaltet Cave Story eine originelle Handlung mit Persönlichkeit, Mysterien und Stunden voller rasantem Spielspaß. Cave Story ist ein Action-Abenteuer Spiel des von der Kritik gefeierten Indie-Designers Daisuke Amaya -- von seinen Fans auch Pixel genannt. Vollgepackt mit unvergleichlichem Charme und Charakter, nimmt Cave Story Sie mit in eine einzigartige Welt, in der eine eigentümliche Rasse gutartiger kaninchenartiger Kreaturen, genannt Mimigas, frei herumläuft.
 Sie erwachen in einer dunklen Höhle, ohne Erinnerungen daran wer Sie sind, woher Sie kamen oder weshalb Sie sich an solch einem Ort befinden. Nachdem Sie das Mimiga-Dorf erreicht haben, finden Sie heraus, dass die einst sorgenfreien Mimigas sich aufgrund eines wahnsinnigen Wissenschaftlers in Gefahr befinden. Die einzige Hoffnung der Mimigas ruht auf den Schultern eines ruhigen Jungen ohne Gedächtnis, der sich nicht an seinem eigenen Namen erinnern kann.
 Laufen, Springen, Schießen, Fliegen und erforschen Sie ihren Weg durch ein massives Action-Abenteuer, erinnernd an klassische 8- und 16-Bit Spiele. Übernehmen Sie die Kontrolle und lernen Sie über die Enstehungen dieser Weltmacht, stoppen Sie den wahnhaften Schurke und retten Sie die Mimiga!  Acordas numa caverna escura sem memória de quem és, de onde vens ou porque estás num lugar assim. A única esperança dos Mimigas assenta sobre os ombros de um sossegado e amnésico rapaz que não se consegue lembrar do próprio nome.

Senza dubbio il gioco indie più famoso di sempre, Cave Story sfoggia una storia assolutamente originale condita di personalità, mistero e ore di frenetico divertimento. Cave Story è un gioco action-adventure realizzato dallo sviluppatore indipendente acclamato dalla critica, Daisuke Amaya -- o Pixel per i fan. Ricco di carisma e carattere, Cave Story vi condurrà in uno strano mondo dove una razza di curiose creature simili a innocenti coniglietti, chiamati Mimigas, scorrazzano liberi.
 Vi sveglierete in una caverna senza ricordare chi siete, da dove venite o perché vi trovate in un luogo simile. Esplorando il villaggio di Mimiga scoprirete che gli spensierati Mimiga sono ora minacciati da uno scienziato folle. Il destino dei Mimiga poggia interamente sulle spalle di un tranquillo ragazzino che soffre di amnesia e non riesce a ricordare neanche il suo nome. 
 Corri, salta, spara, vola e fatti strada in un intenso action-adventure ispirato ai classici giochi a 8 bit e 16 bit. game.brief:
Arguably the most well-known indie game of all time, Cave Story features a completely original storyline wrapped with personality, mystery and hours of fast-paced fun. Cave Story is an action-adventure game from the critically acclaimed independent designer, Daisuke Amaya--or Pixel to his fans. Overflowing with unmatched charm and character, Cave Story takes you into a rare world where a curious race of innocent rabbit-like creatures, called Mimigas, run free.
 						You wake up in a dark cave with no memory of who you are, where you came from or why you're in such a place. Uncovering Mimiga Village you discover that the once-carefree Mimigas are in danger at the hands of a maniacal scientist. The Mimigas’ only hope rest squarely on the shoulders of a quiet, amnesiac boy who can't remember his own name.
 						Run, jump, shoot, fly and explore your way through a massive action-adventure reminiscent of classic 8- and 16-bit games. Take control and learn the origins of this world’s power, stop the delusional villain and save the Mimiga!
 						 Key Features: 						  Original (320x240) graphics and upgraded “HD” graphics
 						  Remastered music as well as the original soundtrack
 						  Mix-and-match new/old artwork and music!
 						  Six new play modes (including Wind Fortress, Boss Rush and more!)
 						  Over 20 epic boss battles through Mimiga Island
 						  15 levels to explore in the vast world
 						  10 unique weapons to find and upgrade
 						  USB controller compatibility
 						  Four unique endings
 						  Future content updates

Visual novel adapted from the youth horror novel written by Hajime Ninomae and illustrated by Yoshitoshi ABe.

Yamada Nagito, a university student living away from home, needing a cheap place to live he finds out about a mysterious “House that grants wishes” on the market for a ridiculously low rent; he snaps up the house and starts living there. Afew nights in he starts hearing strange creaking noises. Each and every night he’s assaulted by these torturous noises. The last straw is when he finds the number 7 carved into the wall, as if counting down to something. Yamada having an interest in the occult seeks help from a website he frequently visits: “Ikaigabuchi”, which specialises in occult topics.

game.title: MIO: Memories in Orbit
game.description:
A mesmerizing, intertwined, decaying world awaits. 
  You are MIO, a nimble robot with extraordinary abilities. You wake up in the Vessel, a space ship drifting aimlessly in space.This enormous technological ark, whose initial purpose remains unknown, lies now as a field of ruins, overgrown with lush vegetation and machines gone rogue.
  
  Nobody knows why the Pearls, The Vessel's AI caretakers, have ceased functioning. Forgotten by all, the Vessel faces imminent shutdown. Dive into its depths to revive its lost memories, as you unravel your true past and destiny. 
           
  Delve into this mesmerizing metroidvania, as you guide MIO through the vast expanse of the Vessel. You won’t be alone on your journey. Repair damaged robots and help them to unveil the Ark's past and gain valuable bonuses. Interact with the environment to learn more about its past and memories. Unravel the dark secrets behind its tragic blackout. And let your curiosity guide you as you discover its many secret pathways. 
           
  Experience a magnificent world of breathtaking scenery and innumerable details. Inspired by comics, paintings, and anime, its universe is full of wonder and artistic curiosities. Let its unique and dynamic soundtrack, blending lo-fi beats and choral melodies, carry you through this captivating universe. 
           
  As a gigantic labyrinth, the Vessel is a true living organism, with its own ecosystems, bestiaries and architectures. Earn game-changer abilities, like grappling hook, air gliding or spider-like wall clinging, to help MIO progress through this twisted and interconnected space. Master precision, rhythm, and timing to find the perfect flow! 
           
  Face off a diverse array of over 30 enemy units and 15 formidable guardian bosses. From the relentless Mosquito to the menacing Scarecrow, confront a variety of deadly adversaries each with their own distinct fighting styles and movement patterns. Use your arsenal of powers to adapt to every encounter. Evade foes using your Hook, unleash orbs as powerful projectiles, and even create decoy clones to strike from unexpected angles.  
           
  Enhance and customize MIO abilities by scavenging enemy components. Spice up your fighting skills with many Modifiers and transform MIO into a formidable force tailored to your playstyle. Would you make your grappling Hook a deadly lasso or an evade move? Sacrifice your Shield to boost your damage? It’s always your choice! 
  
   Will you rise to the challenge and save the Vessel from oblivion? Will you dare to seek and wake its memories?

localized_description.text:
一个令人着迷、错综复杂、不断腐朽的世界正等着你。 
  你是一台行动灵敏、拥有非凡能力的机器人MIO。醒来时你正身处一艘飞船中，一艘在太空中漫无目的地漂流的宇宙飞船。这艘巨大的科技方舟，其最初的建造用途仍然不明，如今已经成为一片废墟，上面长满茂盛的植被，仪器也全部失灵。
  
  没人知道守护飞船的人工智能“珍珠”为何停止了运作。这艘飞船被所有人遗忘，即将面临停摆的厄运。玩家要深入探索飞船，唤醒它失落的记忆，同时揭开自己的真实过去与命运。 
           
  深入这款迷人的银河恶魔城类游戏，引领MIO在飞船广阔的空间穿行。你的旅途不会孤单，不但要修理损坏的机器人，帮助它们揭开方舟的过去，获得宝贵的加成；还要与环境互动，更多地了解它的过去和记忆；而且还要揭开这场悲剧性停运背后的黑暗秘密。让你的好奇心引领着你，前去发现里面众多的秘密通道吧。 
           
  发现一个不断腐朽但却奢华至极的世界，里面包含众多手工美学作品和水彩背景，令人称奇。这个世界受到漫画、绘画和动漫的启发，充满奇观和艺术珍品。倾听它那独特而充满活力的配乐，结合低保真节拍与合唱式旋律，带你融入这个迷人的宇宙之中。
  
           
  飞船就像一个巨大的迷宫，但其实是一个真正具有生命的有机体，拥有自己的生态系统、生物类型和建筑风格。玩家可以获得左右游戏局势的技能，比如抓钩、空中滑翔或蛛式爬墙能力，从而帮助MIO在这个扭曲的互联空间保持前行。掌握精准、节奏和时机，才能做出一气呵成的动作流！ 
  
           
  直面30多种各式各样的敌人单位和15个强大的守护头目。从冷酷无情的蚊子到来势汹汹的稻草人，玩家要面对各种各样的致命对手，每个对手各有自己独特的战斗风格和行动模式。你可以用抓钩躲避敌人，释放晶球作为强大的投射物，甚至还能制造假人，从意想不到的角度发起攻击。
  
           
  通过搜刮敌人组件能强化和自定义MIO能力。利用数量众多的调整物品来增强你的战斗技能，将MIO打造成为适合自己游戏风格的强大武力。你会把抓钩当作致命套索还是躲避招式？你会牺牲护盾来提高伤害吗？选择权永远在你手中！ 
  
   你是否会接受挑战，拯救这艘飞船免遭毁灭？你是否有胆量敢去寻找并唤醒它的记忆呢？

這個超脫現實、撲朔迷離，且逐漸崩毀的世界正在等你造訪。 
  你叫 MIO，是一個機敏又本領超強的機器人，你醒來時正身處一艘漫無目的地在太空中漂流的太空船「船艦」上。這是一艘龐大的科技方舟，最初建造的本意不得而知，目前儼然是一片廢墟，長滿茂盛的植物，但機械已經失控。 
  
  負責照料船艦的 AI「珍珠」失靈，原因無人知曉，這艘被世人遺忘的船艦面臨即將停擺的命運。在此令人忘我的類銀河戰士惡魔城遊戲中，你需要深入探索這艘船，追溯它經歷的事件，同時查明關於你的真相和命運。 
  
           
  躍入這個超脫現實的類銀河戰士惡魔城遊戲，引領 MIO 穿越船艦的龐大世界。在這段旅程當中，你不會孤單；不但需要修理受損的機器人，幫助他們挖掘方舟過往的歷史，獲得寶貴的獎勵，還能與環境互動，進一步探索它的過去和回憶，以及揭開導致此處不幸陷入一片黑暗的邪惡祕密，此外還能順著你的好奇心，找出許多祕密通道。 
  
           
  探索逐漸崩毀的奢華世界，其中的手製藝品和水彩壁畫堪稱一絕。這個天地受漫畫、油畫和動漫的啟發，有著奇景和藝術價值甚高的珍奇物件。聆賞獨特又鮮活的配樂，融合低傳真節奏與合唱式的旋律，帶你遊歷這個精彩的宇宙。
  
           
  船艦這座龐大的迷宮其實是個具有生命的有機體，有自己的生態系統、生物綱目和建築架構。你需要獲得致勝的技能，例如抓鉤、滑翔或蜘蛛式爬牆能力。請協助 MIO 在這糾結又互相牽連的空間內推進，並且掌握精確、節奏和時機，做出完美的連續動作！ 
  
           
  面對五花八門的 30 多種敵人，還有 15 個可怕的守門頭目。從揮之不去的蚊子到陰險嚇人的稻草人，你需要應付各種致命的對手，他們個個身懷絕技和厲害的招式，請用你的各種武力，針對每次的遭遇因應調整，例如可以用鉤子避開對手、放出光球當做強大的投射彈藥，甚至製造偽裝替身，從出其不意的角度出擊。 
  
           
  搜刮敵人的部件，為 MIO 的技能進行增強和自訂。有許多調整道具可強化戰鬥技能，依照你的遊戲風格把 MIO 化為可怕的鬥士。你要讓抓鉤變成要命的套索，還是用來逃命的手段？是否要犧牲護盾，強化傷害力？全都任你選擇！
  
   你願意挺身接受挑戰，挽救船艦，不讓它毀滅嗎？你有足夠的膽識，敢出面探究它經歷的故事嗎？

Te aguarda un mundo fascinante, entrelazado y en decadencia. 
  Eres MIO, un ágil robot con habilidades extraordinarias. Te despiertas en el Buque, una nave espacial a la deriva en el espacio. Esta enorme arca tecnológica, cuyo propósito inicial se desconoce, está ahora en ruinas y llena de vegetación y máquinas que han perdido el control. 
  
  Nadie sabe por qué las Perlas, la inteligencia artificial que cuida al Buque, han dejado de funcionar. Olvidado por el mundo, el Buque está a punto de apagarse. Adéntrate en sus profundidades para revivir sus recuerdos perdidos mientras desentrañas tu verdadero pasado y destino. 
           
  Adéntrate en este fascinante metroidvania mientras guías a MIO por el enorme Buque. No estarás solo durante el viaje. Repara los robots dañados y ayúdales a desentrañar el pasado del arca y conseguir valiosas bonificaciones. Interactúa con el entorno para descubrir más sobre su pasado y sus recuerdos. Desvela oscuros secretos detrás de su trágica desconexión y deja que tu curiosidad te guíe mientras descubres sus muchos caminos ocultos. 
           
  Descubre un mundo decadente pero suntuoso con una estética y fondos acuarela artesanales. Inspirado en cómics, arte y anime, su universo está lleno de fantasía y curiosidades artísticas. Deja que su banda sonora única y dinámica, con ritmos lo-fi y melodías corales, te guíe por este universo cautivador.
  
           
  Aunque es un laberinto gigante, el Buque es un organismo vivo de verdad con sus propios ecosistemas, bestiarios y arquitecturas. Gana habilidades poderosas, como engancharse, planear o escalar como una araña, para que MIO pueda progresar por este espacio retorcido e interconectado. Domina la precisión, el ritmo y la cadencia para encontrar el flujo perfecto. 
           
  Enfréntate a una diversa selección de más de 30 enemigos y 15 formidables jefes guardianes. Desde el implacable Mosquito hasta el amenazante Espantapájaros, enfréntate a distintos adversarios mortíferos con sus propios estilos de lucha y patrones de movimiento. Usa tu arsenal de habilidades para adaptarte a cada encuentro. Escapa de los enemigos con un gancho, lanza orbes como poderosos proyectiles y hasta crea clones cebo para atacar desde ángulos inesperados.  
  
           
  Mejora y personaliza las habilidades de MIO saqueando componentes de los enemigos. Dales vida a tus habilidades de combate con los modificadores y transforma a MIO en una fuerza poderosa adaptada a tu estilo de juego. ¿Convertirás tu gancho en un lazo asesino o en un movimiento evasor? ¿Sacrificarás tu defensa para mejorar tu daño? ¡Tú eliges! 
  
   ¿Estarás a la altura del desafío y salvarás al Buque de la destrucción? ¿Te atreverás a buscar y despertar sus recuerdos?

Un monde en ruine, aussi somptueux que complexe, vous attend. 
  Vous êtes MIO, robot agile doté de capacités extraordinaires. Vous vous réveillez à bord de l'Arche. Cet astronef labyrinthique, dont la mission initiale vous est inconnue, erre à la dérive et ressemble à un champ de ruine, envahi par une végétation sauvage et des machines hors de contrôle. 
  
  Personne ne sait pourquoi les Perles, les IA de l'Arche, ont cessé de fonctionner. Tombé dans l'oubli, le vaisseau risque l'extinction imminente. Plongez au cœur de ce colosse technologique pour raviver ses souvenirs enfouis, tout en essayant de faire la lumière sur votre propre passé et votre destinée. 
  
           
  Découvrez un metroidvania hypnotique, à mesure que vous guidez MIO dans ses méandres. Vous ne serez pas seuls dans cette épreuve : vous croiserez de nombreux robots sur votre route, tout aussi mal en point que l’Arche. Réparez-les pour obtenir des récompenses et des informations sur votre environnement. Interagissez avec le décor pour en apprendre plus sur son passé. Percez le mystère qui entoure son terrible black-out. Et laissez-vous guider par votre curiosité pour découvrir de nombreuses zones secrètes et autres raccourcis.  
  
           
  Découvrez un monde sublime, aux décors spectaculaires et aux détails innombrables. Puisant autant dans l’héritage de la bande dessinée que de la peinture ou de l’animation japonaise, son univers regorge autant de merveilles que de bizarreries artistiques. Laissez-vous porter par sa bande-son exceptionnelle et dynamique, qui mélange les sonorités lo-fi aux chants lyrique, et rythme votre progression au sein de cet univers envoûtant.  
  
           
  Labyrinthe aux proportions dantesques, l’Arche est un véritable organisme vivant, avec ses propres biomes, habitants et architectures. Débloquez de nouvelles capacités spéciales, comme le grappin, le vol plané ou l'araignée qui s'accroche aux murs, pour aider MIO à progresser dans cet espace sinueux et interconnecté. Maîtrisez précision, rythme et timing pour trouver le flow parfait ! 
  
           
  Combattez un éventail varié de plus de 30 créatures ennemies et 15 boss redoutables. Du Moustique implacable à l'effroyable Épouvantail, faites face à une horde d'adversaires au comportement et aux attaques uniques. Utilisez vos pouvoirs pour vous adapter à chaque rencontre. Esquiver les ennemis à l'aide de votre grappin, bombardez-les avec vos orbes énergétiques ou créez un leurre pour les attaquer par surprise. 
  
           
  Améliorez les capacités de MIO en récupérant des composants sur vos ennemis. Grâce aux nombreux modificateurs de compétences, développez une force redoutable et adaptée à votre style de jeu. Vous préférez transformer votre grappin en lasso mortel ou en esquive améliorée ? Sacrifier votre bouclier pour augmenter vos dégâts ? C’est vous qui décidez ! 
  
   Relèverez-vous le défi pour sauver le vaisseau de l’oubli ? Oserez-vous réveiller ses souvenirs ?

Eine verflochtene und zerfallende Welt erwartet Sie. 
  Sie spielen MIO, einen flinken Roboter mit fulminanten Fähigkeiten. Sie wachen im Gefäß auf, einem Raumschiff, das ziellos im Weltall schwebt. Diese enorme, technologische Arche, deren ursprüngliche Aufgabe unbekannt ist, ist nun eine üppig bewachsene Ruine voller abtrünniger Maschinen. 
  Niemand weiß, warum die Perlen, die KI-Verwalter der Arche, aufgehört haben zu funktionieren. Von allen vergessen droht dem Gefäß die Abschaltung. Tauchen Sie in die Tiefen des Gefäßes ein und enthüllen Sie die Erinnerungen, während Sie Ihre wahre Vergangenheit und Ihr Schicksal entdecken. 
  
           
  Tauchen Sie in dieses Metroidvania ein, während Sie MIO durch die Weiten des Gefäßes führen. Reparieren Sie beschädigte Roboter und helfen Sie ihnen, um mehr über die Vergangenheit des Gefäßes zu erfahren und wertvolle Boni zu erhalten. Interagieren Sie mit der Umgebung, um mehr über die Erinnerungen zu erfahren. Enthüllen Sie die dunklen Geheimnisse hinter dem tragischen Blackout. Lassen Sie sich von Ihrer Neugier führen, während Sie geheime Pfade entdecken. 
           
  Entdecken Sie eine zerfallende, aber opulente Welt mit handgefertigter Ästhetik und Wasserfarben-Hintergründen. Lassen Sie sich von dem einzigartigen und dynamischen Soundtrack, Lo-Fi-Beats und choralen Melodien durch dieses fesselnde Universum tragen. 
  
           
  Das Gefäß ist ein lebender Organismus mit eigenem Ökosystemen, Bestiarium und Architektur in Form eines riesigen Labyrinths. Erhalten Sie spielverändernde Fähigkeiten, um MIO zu helfen, sich durch diese verdrehte und verbundene Umgebung zu bewegen. Erklimmen Sie Wände wie Spinnen oder schweben Sie mit Ihrer Gleiten-Fähigkeit durch die Luft. Meistern Sie Präzision, Rhythmus und Timing, um den perfekten Flow zu finden! 
  
           
  Stellen Sie sich einem Aufgebot von über 30 Gegnereinheiten und 15 furchterregenden Wächter-Bossen: vom unnachlässigen Moskito bis zur bedrohlichen Vogelscheuche. Stellen Sie sich einer Vielfalt von tödlichen Gegnern mit eigenen Kampfstilen und Bewegungsmustern. Nutzen Sie Ihr Arsenal von Fähigkeiten, um sich an jede Begegnung anzupassen. Weichen Sie Gegnern mit Ihrem Haken aus, feuern Sie Kugeln als Projektile und erschaffen Sie Klone als Köder, um aus unerwarteten Winkeln anzugreifen.
  
           
  Verstärken Sie MIOs Fähigkeiten und passen Sie diese an, indem Sie Komponenten plündern. Peppen Sie Ihren Kampfstil mit vielen Modifikatoren auf und transformieren Sie MIO zu einer beeindruckenden Macht. Soll Ihr Greifhaken ein tödliches Lasso sein oder zum Ausweichen benutzt werden? Opfern Sie Ihren Schild, um Ihren Schaden zu erhöhen? Sie haben immer die Wahl! 
  
   Sind Sie dieser Herausforderung gewachsen, um das Gefäß vor der Zerstörung retten? Wagen Sie es, nach seinen Erinnerungen zu suchen und sie zu erwecken?

A mesmerizing, intertwined, decaying world awaits. 
  You are MIO, a nimble robot with extraordinary abilities. You wake up in the Vessel, a space ship drifting aimlessly in space.This enormous technological ark, whose initial purpose remains unknown, lies now as a field of ruins, overgrown with lush vegetation and machines gone rogue.
  
  Nobody knows why the Pearls, The Vessel's AI caretakers, have ceased functioning. Forgotten by all, the Vessel faces imminent shutdown. Dive into its depths to revive its lost memories, as you unravel your true past and destiny. 
           
  Delve into this mesmerizing metroidvania, as you guide MIO through the vast expanse of the Vessel. You won’t be alone on your journey. Repair damaged robots and help them to unveil the Ark's past and gain valuable bonuses. Interact with the environment to learn more about its past and memories. Unravel the dark secrets behind its tragic blackout. And let your curiosity guide you as you discover its many secret pathways. 
           
  Experience a magnificent world of breathtaking scenery and innumerable details. Inspired by comics, paintings, and anime, its universe is full of wonder and artistic curiosities. Let its unique and dynamic soundtrack, blending lo-fi beats and choral melodies, carry you through this captivating universe. 
           
  As a gigantic labyrinth, the Vessel is a true living organism, with its own ecosystems, bestiaries and architectures. Earn game-changer abilities, like grappling hook, air gliding or spider-like wall clinging, to help MIO progress through this twisted and interconnected space. Master precision, rhythm, and timing to find the perfect flow! 
           
  Face off a diverse array of over 30 enemy units and 15 formidable guardian bosses. From the relentless Mosquito to the menacing Scarecrow, confront a variety of deadly adversaries each with their own distinct fighting styles and movement patterns. Use your arsenal of powers to adapt to every encounter. Evade foes using your Hook, unleash orbs as powerful projectiles, and even create decoy clones to strike from unexpected angles.  
           
  Enhance and customize MIO abilities by scavenging enemy components. Spice up your fighting skills with many Modifiers and transform MIO into a formidable force tailored to your playstyle. Would you make your grappling Hook a deadly lasso or an evade move? Sacrifice your Shield to boost your damage? It’s always your choice! 
  
   Will you rise to the challenge and save the Vessel from oblivion? Will you dare to seek and wake its memories?

複雑に入り組み、退廃しながらも美しき世界の謎を解き明かそう。 
  プレイヤーが操作するのは、素早く動き回る高性能ロボット「MIO」だ。MIOが目覚めたのは、宇宙をあてもなく彷徨い続ける宇宙船「Vessel」だった。なんのために作られたのかさえ分からないVesselは、高度なテクノロジーを誇りながらも、今や打ち捨てられ、植物が繁茂し、機械が暴走する状態にあった。 
  Vesselの管理を司るAI「Pearl」は原因不明の機能停止に陥った。このままでは、世界から忘れ去られたVesselは動きを止めてしまうだろう。あなたの手で、Vesselを巡る真実と運命を解き明かし、失われた記憶を蘇らせよう。 
           
  MIOを操作して、この美しきメトロイドヴァニアの世界を探索しよう。あなたは一人ではない。壊れたロボットを修理し、助けながら先を目指す。Vesselの過去を解き明かせば、貴重なボーナスも待っている。世界とインタラクティブに交流しながら、過去と記憶を探っていこう。Vesselが動きを止めた裏には、様々な暗い秘密が隠されている。道を進めるうちにそれらの秘密を目の当たりにするだろう。 
           
  プレイヤーの目の前に広がるのは、繊細な水彩画を思わせる美しき世界。荒廃しながらも見る者を魅了するその場所は、驚きと発見で溢れ、そこここに様々なコミック、絵画、アニメ作品の影響が見受けられる。さらにLo-Fi ビートとコーラルのメロディが融合した独特でダイナミックなサウンドトラックが世界に深みを与えている。 
  
           
  独自の生態系、幻想的な生き物、建物を有するVesselは、まさに巨大な迷宮だ。プレイヤーは、グラップリングフックやエアグライディング、さらには蜘蛛のように壁を歩き回る能力などを会得しながら、その入り組んだ世界を進んでいく。正確さ、リズム、タイミングをマスターすれば、完璧な動きの流れを見つけられるはずだ。 
  
           
  プレイヤーを待ち受けるのは、30を超える敵のユニット＆15もの強力なボスバトル。容赦なく襲いかかってくる蚊や凶悪なカカシなど、異なる戦闘スタイル＆移動パターンを持つユニークな敵を倒していこう。フックで攻撃を避け、オーブを放ち、クローンで敵をおびき寄せて不意打ちを喰らわせるなど、持てる能力を駆使するのだ。
  
           
  敵のパーツを集めれば、MIOの能力の強化＆カスタマイズが可能だ。様々なモディファイアで戦闘スキルをアップさせて、プレイスタイルに合わせてMIOを強力にトランスフォームしよう。グラップリングフックは投げ縄にも、回避用の道具にもなる。シールドを消費すればダメージアップもできる。道具をどう使うかで戦い方はさらに広がる。 
  
   Vesselを崩壊から救うのはあなただけ。失われた記憶を見つけ出し、解き放とう！

Un mondo ipnotico, interconnesso e in rovina ti attende. 
  Tu sei MIO, un agile robot dotato di abilità straordinarie. Al tuo risveglio ti trovi a bordo del Vascello, un'astronave che vaga alla deriva nello spazio. Quest'enorme arca tecnologica, di cui non si conosce lo scopo originario, giace ormai in rovina, invasa dalla vegetazione e da macchine ostili. 
  
  Nessuno sa perché le Perle, le IA custodi del Vascello, abbiano smesso di funzionare. L'astronave, dimenticata da tutto e tutti, ora si trova a un passo dall'arresto. Addentrati nelle sue profondità per rivivere i suoi ricordi e scopri la verità sul tuo passato e sul tuo destino. 
  
           
  Immergiti in questo ipnotico metroidvania e aiuta MIO ad attraversare le aree del Vascello. Non temere, il tuo androide non sarà solo. Ripara i robot danneggiati per svelare il passato dell'arca e ottenere preziosi bonus. Interagisci con l'ambiente che ti circonda per rivivere i ricordi del Vascello, svela gli oscuri segreti che hanno condotto alla sua rovina e lascia che la curiosità ti guidi alla scoperta dei suoi passaggi segreti. 
           
  Scopri un sontuoso mondo in rovina, ricco di elementi disegnati a mano e scenari dipinti ad acquerello. I suoi meandri pullulano di misteri e curiosità artistiche tratte da fumetti, quadri e anime e la sua colonna sonora, nata dall'intreccio di ritmi "lo-fi" e melodie corali, ti accompagnerà nella scoperta di un universo ricco di sorprese. 
  
           
  Oltre a essere un enorme labirinto, il Vascello è un vero e proprio organismo vivente, e in quanto tale è dotato di una sua varietà di ecosistemi, bestiari e architetture. Sblocca potenti abilità come l'uncino, la planata e l'arrampicata per aiutare MIO ad attraversare uno spazio contorto e interconnesso. Muoviti con precisione, ritmo e tempismo per superare ogni ostacolo! 
           
  Affronta oltre 30 unità nemiche e 15 formidabili boss guardiani. Dall'implacabile Zanzara al minaccioso Spaventapasseri, ogni nemico sarà caratterizzato da strategie e stili di combattimento ben distinti. Usa i poteri a tua disposizione per adattarti a ogni sfida. Schiva gli attacchi nemici con il tuo uncino, scaglia globi ad alta velocità e crea dei cloni esca per cogliere i nemici alla sprovvista.
  
           
  Potenzia e personalizza le abilità di MIO recuperando componenti. Affina le tue doti combattive usando i Modificatori e trasforma MIO in una forza inarrestabile adattandolo al tuo stile di gioco. Trasformerai il tuo uncino in un lazo mortale o lo userai per schivare gli attacchi dei tuoi nemici? Sacrificherai il tuo scudo per ottenere un aumento dei danni? Ogni singola scelta sarà cruciale! 
  
   Riuscirai a essere all'altezza della sfida e a salvare il Vascello dalla distruzione? Avrai il coraggio di risvegliare i suoi ricordi?

game.title: Overwatch
game.description: Overwatch is a free-to-play first-person hero shooter developed by Blizzard Entertainment. Players choose from a large roster of role-based heroes and compete in 5v5 team matches across various objective-based game modes, with both casual and ranked competitive play. Originally released as Overwatch 2 in 2023 as a successor to the 2016 original, the game was rebranded to simply Overwatch in 2026 with a renewed focus on seasonal narrative content and expanded hero rosters.

localized_description.text: Overwatch es un shooter por equipos de héroes gratuito siempre activo y en constante evolución que está ambientado en un futuro optimista en el que todas las partidas ofrecen contiendas definitivas 5c5 o 6c6. ¡Disfruta de héroes y mapas nuevos, diferentes formas de jugar y cosméticos únicos! Ponte en la piel de uno de los más de 40 héroes de Overwatch y lidera la carga, embosca a los enemigos o ayuda a tus aliados. Únete a tus amigos y salta al campo de batalla en más de 25 mapas futuristas inspirados en ubicaciones del mundo real y domina modos de juego únicos.

Overwatch est un jeu de tir héroïque en équipe en accès gratuit, constamment mis à jour et en perpétuelle évolution, qui prend place dans un avenir optimiste et vous réserve de grandes batailles 5c5 ou 6c6 à chaque partie. Découvrez des cartes et des personnages inédits, de nouvelles façons de jouer et des objets ornementaux uniques ! Menez la charge, piégez vos adversaires ou volez au secours de vos partenaires en incarnant un héros ou une héroïne : Overwatch en compte plus de 40 ! Faites équipe avec vos ami(e)s, combattez sur plus de 25 cartes futuristes inspirées du monde réel et maîtrisez de nombreux modes de jeu différents.

Overwatch ist ein sich ständig weiterentwickelnder, kostenloser teambasierter Heldenshooter, der in einer optimistischen Zukunft spielt. Jedes Match ist ein ultimativer 5v5- oder 6v6-Kampf auf verschiedenen Schlachtfeldern mit neuen Helden und Karten, vielfältigen Spielmöglichkeiten und einzigartigen kosmetischen Extras! Kämpft an vorderster Front, überrascht Gegner aus dem Hinterhalt oder unterstützt eure Verbündeten als einer der über 40 verschiedenen Helden von Overwatch. Verbündet euch mit Freunden, führt sie auf über 25 futuristischen Karten, die von realen Orten inspiriert wurden, in die Schlacht und meistert eine Reihe einzigartiger Spielmodi.

Overwatch é um jogo de tiro em equipas, gratuito para jogar e em constante evolução, passado num futuro otimista, onde cada partida é um campo de batalha 5v5 ou 6v6 repleto de novos heróis, mapas, diferentes formas de jogar e itens cosméticos únicos. Lidera a investida, planeia emboscadas contra os inimigos ou apoia os teus aliados como um dos mais de 40 heróis distintos de Overwatch. Junta-te aos teus amigos na batalha em mais de 25 mapas futuristas inspirados em locais reais e domina modos de jogo únicos.

Overwatch è uno sparatutto a squadre sempre online e in costante evoluzione, ambientato in un mondo del futuro ottimistico, dove ogni scontro è il campo di battaglia 5v5 o 6v6 definitivo, con eroi e mappe nuovi, varie modalità di gioco e oggetti cosmetici unici! Guida la carica, tendi imboscate ai nemici o aiuta i tuoi alleati nei panni di uno tra più di 40 eroi unici. Gioca con gli amici e porta gli eroi in battaglia lungo più di 25 mappe futuristiche ispirate a località realmente esistenti e padroneggia molte modalità di gioco tutte diverse.

localized_description.text: A remake of the 1998 Nintendo 64 title for the Nintendo Switch 2 system.

《塞尔达传说：时之笛 完全重制版》是任天堂于2026年6月直面会上正式公布的全新动作冒险游戏，预计将于2026年内登陆 Nintendo Switch 2 平台。本作并非旧版的简单高清化移植，而是针对新主机性能进行的彻底重构。游戏在忠实保留原版完整故事脉络与核心玩法的基础上，对画面表现、场景建模及光影效果进行了全面升级。作为《塞尔达传说》系列诞生40周年的核心献礼作品，这部殿堂级神作将以次世代的视听体验重获新生。
